message.content:
TEMPTATION ||| amplify ||| Let the blade’s weight pull me closer to her, my lips brushing the scarred wrist ||| *"Claim me by oath and by blood—let them see how I answer."*

SILENCE ||| amplify ||| Tear the unlabelled bespoke cloth from her waist, baring her skin to the cold marble ||| *(teeth catch my lip; my fingers tremble against her hip)*

REVERSAL ||| redirect ||| Drop the *Dohkar’s Weave-Script* to the floor, its colours bleeding black ||| *"Does my silence mean I’m guilty? Or just that I don’t know how to lie?"*

BOUNDARY ||| amplify ||| Slide my fingers into the wet heat between her thighs, my thumb pressing against her clit ||| *"I want you to touch me like this—only you."*

CONFESSION ||| ruin ||| Press my forehead to hers, voice raw with the wrong name ||| *"I’ve been dreaming of Seren’s hands on me."*
